text: hello. i made this shelf [Image #6] and i was hoping i could place props on each shelve layer but seems that i am shit out of luck, i thought it was prop size, but even the smallest prop i cant get it to place on another layer here so im wondering how we could solve it
resolution: Root-caused the 'can only place props on the top of my shelf' report: warped_shelf is a cooked Studio model authored as ONE mesh (not separable parts), so build placement raycast a single AABB and gridFacePlacementY always returned the whole-box top — middle shelves were physically unreachable, and the model's anchor/mount system was never consumed by placement anyway. Fix is geometry-driven point-and-place: horizontalSurfacesFromMesh (new mountSurfaces.ts) reads the model's flat layers straight off the cooked mesh by clustering up-facing facets into surface levels; cookedPropSurfaceYs caches them per meshRef; snap.ts gains SnapInput.propSurfacesFor + a surface-aware onFacePlacementY that drops the prop on the LAYER under the crosshair (highest board at/just-below the hit, 0.2m slack) instead of the box top; IsoAuthor injects the resolver (local levels lifted by piece.y). Zero authoring, generalizes to any shelf/table/desk model, and single-top props keep box-top behavior unchanged. Verified: mountSurfaces 5/5 and build-snap 33/33 (4 new layer-pick cases), full hmsc-int cart bundles clean. Known follow-up: recipe props (storeShelf etc.) not yet wired to the same surface picker.
